description: DAO-ENUM (T), variant: Refresh while an enumerator is live. A second Database of the same file creates table Rf1 (the held TableDefs does not see it); TableDefs is enumerated and in the body of every Next the item Name is read, TableDefs.Refresh is called and Count read; the walk's later Next, Reset, Next, Skip and Clone show whether Refresh invalidates or extends the enumerator.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
